description: This file is an HTML document that defines the structure, style, and interactive behavior of a web-based database visualizer interface. It includes elements such as database list, table list, data display sections, and associated JavaScript for fetching and rendering database data dynamically.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table within a database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders fetched data into an HTML table, handling wide content and large data sets.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell data, including objects and long strings, with expand/collapse behavior.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for objects and long strings for better readability.
